text:
Anton Frondell is 19, the third overall pick in 2025, and already the Blackhawks' answer to hard questions. When Connor Bedard went out with a shoulder injury, Frondell moved onto the top line, and The Athletic has written about him as Chicago's shutdown center.

That's a big ask, and the numbers show it. Chicago gets only 35% of the expected goals with him on at five on five and is almost nine points worse than when he sits. He has 11 points in 23 games, four goals on 4.4 expected, which is about right for what he's getting.

The shot is the standout tool: NHL Edge has his hardest at the 98th percentile among forwards. His nine-shot night in Boston on Oct 31 is the version of him Chicago wants to see more often.

Forwards picked in the top five tend to land: 54 of 56 with four seasons reached 200 NHL games. Mark Lazerus of The Athletic reported he left the Calgary game on Nov 21, with coach Jeff Blashill saying he's been battling a nagging injury or two. What to watch: his health first, and then whether the defensive numbers improve once Bedard is back.
